description: This file defines an abstract class 'GenericMapKeySet' which extends 'GenericMapSet' and provides functionality related to set views of map keys within the package 'org.apache.ofbiz.base.util.collections'.

classes.name: GenericMapKeySet
classes.description: An abstract class extending 'GenericMapSet', representing a set view of a map's keys with methods for removal and source management.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes an item (key) from the underlying map source and returns true if the item was present and removed.
